title: OpenDUNE
subtitle: A reimplementation of Dune II, built with the project's own Makefile.wc — Watcom, DOS4GW

needsData.hint: Dune II v1.07's own DATA/ directory

safepointsNote: These games get their TIME from an interrupt and wait for it inside a loop of their own C -- Heretic's TryRunTics spins on `ticcount`, which only the ISR writes. A safepoint is the only place this runtime can reach into such a loop, so without them the game waits for ever and looks exactly like a hang.
